mod.description: 4X Colony Garrisons & Master Config Hub. Deploys dynamic defense fleets, fleet upkeep, strikes, gadget synergies, and configures Space Diplomacy & Warfare Overhaul (3D Trade Convoys, Philosophy Doctrines, Dreadnoughts & Galactic Secessions).

component.description: Lightweight garrisons (10-15 vessels max) for low-end PCs.
Small task forces (up to 25 vessels) with minimal performance impact.
Balanced 4X gameplay: dynamic Soft-Cap scaling with T-Score, Unlimited-Colony cities, stars, and weaponry rank.
Fortified orbital garrisons (up to 65 vessels on developed hubs).
Massive sector armadas for high-end systems and intense planetary sieges.
100% loyal fleets: disables player/AI garrison mutinies, Zealot Schisms, and background star secessions.
Mild unrest: rare mutinies, shorter 120s Zealot Schisms, and breakaway republics only in 8+ star bankrupt empires.
Full 4X politics: mutinies from bankruptcy/losses, 240s Zealot Schism cascades, SOS alerts, and secessions in 6+ star giants.
Volatile galaxy: double mutiny rates, 360s Zealot Schisms, frequent SOS uprisings, and breakaway republics from 5+ star empires.
Free peacetime garrisons with zero periodic Sporebuck maintenance costs.
Light payroll every 4 minutes; high local spice self-sufficiency for player and AI treasuries.
Balanced maintenance every 3 minutes; rare spices and trade offset garrison expenses.
Strict military budget every 2 minutes; overextended empires without trade risk bankruptcy fast.
Unhappy citizens and excess factories never slow down shipyards or provoke strikes.
Minor shipyard slowdowns and low strike pressure from unhappy industrial cities.
Factory sweatshops and blockades slow shipyards and spark Scientist/Ecologist wartime strikes.
Neglected factory colonies rapidly erupt into shipyard paralysis and orbital mutinies.
Disables custom gadget synergies, Uber-Dreadnoughts, Embassies, Shaman Astral Wardens/Rebirth, and Ecologist Bio-Regen.
Half-strength bonuses for planetary buildings, riot-control tools, Shaman portals, and Ecologist regeneration.
Full 4X synergy: Spice Depots, Uber-Dreadnoughts, Embassies, Shaman Astral Nexus & Rebirth, Ecologist Bio-Regen & Necrosis.
Maximum tactical impact from colonization buildings, ship siege tools, and philosophy lore abilities.
Disables dynamic AI trade networks, spice arbitrage profits, war deterrence, and 3D orbital cargo convoys.
Conservative trade income, compact 3D freighter wings, and up to 3 base routes per empire.
Living spaceports: two-way player & multi-species 3D convoys, convoy plundering, war shock, and 5 base routes per empire.
Bustling galactic hubs: dense 3D cargo fleets, high-yield rare spice arbitrage, and up to 8 base routes per empire.
